about: What FXM's desktop and Android apps trust for signed updates (the YouTube config and resolver module): the Ed25519 public keys whose signatures they accept, and in "revoked" the versions they refuse even when validly signed, per artifact kind, e.g. {"youtube-module": [4]}. The entry below is a placeholder, not a key: while it is the only entry, every build refuses every signed update and uses the copies it ships with. The owner replaces it with the two entries scripts/make-signing-key.sh prints (the signing key and its offline backup). Never put a private key here.

keys.publicKey: PLACEHOLDER-NOT-A-KEY: run scripts/make-signing-key.sh and replace this entry
